IBM AS/400 Administration will possess core technical skills of an IBM AS/400 system in the areas of the following:

  • System Upgrades and maintenance

IBM AS/400 Administration will possess:

  • Critical thinking skills, including abilities in analysis and problem-solving

title: Project Controls Coordinator III
description:
Project Controls Coordinator III
Contract Duration: Contract through 10/12/2026 (High potential for extension)
Location: Duluth, MN
Work Arrangement: Hybrid (In-office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday; remote Wednesday and Friday)
 
Position Summary
Enbridge is seeking a Project Controls Coordinator III (PCC) to support the planning, integration, and oversight of project controls functions across capital projects in Engineering and Construction. This position plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of cost, schedule, and quality control deliverables and provides field-level project cost support on high-risk and complex initiatives.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and implement project controls strategies with integrated cost and schedule functions.
  • Act as a key liaison for contractors in training and supporting EcoSys LEMs (Labor, Equipment, Materials).
  • Ensure contractors provide accurate labor rates and cost estimates.
  • Support Project Controls Advisors (PCAs) in LEM setup, processing, and attestation.
  • Serve as the dedicated Field Cost Analyst (FCA) on large-scale, high-risk projects.
  • Generate detailed cost and performance analysis, including graphs, summaries, and presentations.
  • Support Project Managers with scope definition, change management, and financial tracking.
  • Prepare expenditure forecasts, staffing histograms, and capital cost comparisons.
  • Monitor and compare field and indirect costs against budgets and forecasts.
  • Track project KPIs and collaborate with support teams to drive project execution improvements.
  • Deliver comprehensive variance analyses and project status updates to senior management.
 
Qualifications
Education:
  • Bachelor's Degree or Technical Diploma in Engineering, Finance, Accounting, or a related field. Other post-secondary education may be considered.
Experience:
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in Project Controls or Project Management.
  • Experience in pipeline operations preferred.
Technical Skills:
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (v-lookups, pivot tables, SUMIFS, charting, etc.).
  • Familiarity with Power BI and Power Pivot for data analysis and reporting.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and ERP systems like Oracle/SAP.
  • Strong hands-on experience with EcoSys.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Project Server.
Core Competencies:
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret large data sets.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
  • Proven decision-making, planning, and organizational capabilities.
  • Team-oriented, proactive, and capable of working independently in fast-paced environments.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.

Preferred:
